name: ResumeRadar
tagline: Fair, explainable AI resume screening and career coaching
problem: Recruiters skim hundreds of resumes in seconds per profile
Keyword ATS tools reject good candidates for their wording
Name, gender and college bias creep into screening
Rejected students never learn why or what to fix

stats.label: first human scan of a resume (Ladders eye-tracking study 2018, approx.)
more callbacks for identical resumes, name changed (Bertrand & Mullainathan 2004, approx.)
strong 'ReactJS, JS, TS' resume: keyword ATS vs ResumeRadar (our demo)

solution: Rank resumes against a JD with a transparent weighted score
231-skill ontology understands synonyms: JS = JavaScript, k8s = Kubernetes
Blind mode masks identity; a bias check proves the ranking is unchanged
Students get gaps, a learning plan, bullet rewrites and interview prep

features.title: Explainable match score

features.desc: Flags 'IIT/NIT preferred', age limits and gendered wording

features.title: Learning path
features.desc: Missing skills plus prerequisites ordered by topological sort

features.title: Bullet coach + ATS check
features.desc: Weak bullets rewritten; 9 ATS rules with points and fixes

features.title: Interview prep
features.desc: 115 questions on claimed skills, gaps and your projects

architecture: Browser UI (vanilla JS + SVG) -> recruiter screen, coach, how it works
blind.py -> mask / strip / swap identity spans
extract.py + jd.py + ontology.py -> skills, roles, requirements
tfidf.py + scoring.py -> weighted, explained match score
algorithms: Longest-match alias dictionary with case rules – skill extraction
Sublinear TF-IDF + cosine with skill tokens – context similarity
Weighted linear score with implied/related credit – ranking
Interval union of dated roles – relevant experience
Counterfactual identity swap + Spearman rho – bias check
Kahn topological sort – prerequisite-ordered learning path
tech: Python 3 stdlib only (http.server, re, math, heapq)
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, inline SVG, no CDN
Fully offline, no API keys, no data leaves the laptop
innovation: Fairness verified on every batch, not just claimed
Skill-aware matching: synonyms, implied and related skills
One model serves recruiters and coaches students
